rows.en: I'm going all-out to the very end!
rows.notes: Male only; follows the maguro bun choice in the last round.

rows.en: Always on the attack, huh... I kinda like that...
That's 20 plates for me.
rows.notes: Male x3 (all three endings), female x1 (losing ending).

rows.en: 19 plates...

Yes!
I win!!!

Ugh~
I-I lost...

Oh well, I'll pay the bill.
Aww, man... and there was a part I wanted, too...
...It's fine. Let's split the bill.
Huh? You mean it!?
Yeah. It was fun, after all.

Yaaay~! Thanks,
\p!

(Pigging out once in a while isn't so bad!
It was a good way to blow off steam, too.)
rows.notes: x6: all three endings, both genders.

rows.en: 20 plates...
So it's a draw...
Hmm, no winner, huh~
Aww, there was a part I wanted, but oh well!
rows.notes: Both genders; draw ending, each pays their own.

rows.en: That was fun, Hoshimura.
Right, right? Let's come eat here again!
21 plates...
I-I lost...!!

Yes! Yes, yes, yes!
I woooon!!!
You're way too hyped...

Aww, sorry to make you treat me and all...
Hee-hee-hee!
Well, it was fun, so it's fine.

Let's come again!
We can just split the bill next time!

(Yui suddenly called me out here,
but...)
You're full of energy today too, Yui.
So why did you call me out here?
...How come?
Whaaat~!!
rows.notes: x3: ext_yui_001 female; frd_cla_007 both genders (Claire demands a crepe as punishment).

rows.en:
Uh, yes you do!
I don't know anything about this!!

Oh, last time my opponent was Yuu, wasn't it...
My bad, my bad.
rows.notes: Female only; Yuu Akimizu (given name as in the Japanese).

rows.en: (So Yuu was a victim too...)
Nice and simple.
So the timing of my orders matters too...
So what happens if I win?
Maguro buns to start!

When it comes to dim sum, it's xiaolongbao!
I'll beat the heat with sheer guts!
Maybe I'll go for a sweeeet red bean bun!
Time to pick my second wave!

Shrimp dumplings to switch up the flavor!
I've gotta mix things up...!

It's the big crowd-pleaser.
No way I'm not ordering it...!
rows.notes: Female only; follows the maguro bun choice in round two.

rows.en:
Urp...
My stomach's about to burst...
Time for the final sprint!

Meat would be risky now...
To dodge the leftovers penalty,
I'm moving on to dessert!
rows.notes: Female only; follows the mango pudding choice.

rows.en: I'm going all-out to the very end!
That's 20 plates for me.

Yes!
I win!!!
That was fun, Yui.
I-I lost...!!
You're way too hyped...

(Finally, school's out~
What should I do?)
Ah! Target spotted!!
What's up, Hoshimura?
I've been looking for you!
Why were you looking for me?

There's a favor I wanted to ask...
Will you hear me out?
Depends on what it is...
I want you to show me your EX-Gear!

My EX-Gear?
You've got your own...

Mine's no good for this.
It has to be yours!

O-okay, fine...
I just have to show it to you, right?
All right!
rows.notes: x6: Hoshimura here; player in frd_itk_114 and nml_cla_010 (both genders) when promised a treat.

rows.en: You've got your own, so why mine...
rows.notes: Male x2 (also in the refusal branch), female x1 (same line in her refusal branch).

rows.en:
I wanted to get my hands on a stock EX-Gear.
Mine's all souped-up, and the thingy's all
thingied, so...
rows.notes: Both genders ('are ga are': deliberately vague).

rows.en: So you've already modded yours...

I-it's just tuning...
I haven't done anything naughty!
I see...
rows.notes: x11: player in several scenes, Shirakawa in frd_myk_001/004; generic.

rows.en:
Hmmm...
Yep, the factory radiator's the weak spot!
Argh! I'm itching to fix it!!

(What's Hoshimura going on about? She just
started poking at it on her own...)

...Say, couldn't you let me tinker with it,
just a teeny bit?
...Can't I?
Hmm, what should I do...
Let her mod it
Flatly refuse

Well, I guess it's okay, as long as you
don't break it...
For real!

Alriiight! Just relax, like you're sailing
on a boat made of mud!
rows.notes: Both genders. She garbles the idiom 'ride a big ship' (be reassured) into 'mud boat' (one that sinks); the player answers 'That'll sink!'. Kept the mud boat literally so the comeback works.

rows.en: That'll sink!
It's okay, it's A-okay!
Th-that's not reassuring...

uncertain: c03524: Hoshimura's malapropism 'doro-bune ni notta tsumori de' (mud boat, for the reassuring 'big ship') kept as 'a boat made of mud' so the player's 'That'll sink!' (c03525/c03550) lands.
c03526: 'daijoubui' (daijoubu + V) rendered 'It's okay, it's A-okay!'.
c03509 'All right!' and c03514 'I see...' are shared generics (x6, x11); both read fine in every listed scene.
